title: Orchestrated QA loop for compact quant profiles (FP8/INT8) and automated accuracy gating
creator: Arjun Rao
description: Build an orchestrated end-to-end QA loop that validates FP8 and INT8 quantization profiles against curated golden prompt cohorts and produces deterministic pass/fail gates for CI and canary rollouts. The loop should: (1) run stratified evaluation across latency buckets and context lengths, (2) compute composite fidelity metrics that combine generation similarity (ROUGE/BLEURT-style proxies), logit-level KL, and downstream task regressions, (3) apply adaptive thresholds per-model and per-cohort, and (4) emit rich telemetry (per-layer sensitivity, per-token divergence, and failure traces) to support root-cause debugging and rollback automation.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible runner (CLI + container) that accepts a model artifact and quant profile and returns a JSON verdict (pass/fail) plus the full metric breakdown
Support for golden prompt cohorts segmented by domain, length, and difficulty with sampling reproducibility (seeded replay)
Composite FidelityScore implemented and documented; gating rule configurable in project config (default gate: FidelityScore >= 0.92 or no metric regression > 1.5%)
Per-layer and per-head sensitivity export that maps large accuracy deltas to specific transformer blocks
Integration with CI: on PR -> run smoke subset (fast) and on canary -> run full stratified suite with auto-rollback webhook triggers
Telemetry dashboards created (Grafana) with latency vs fidelity heatmaps and alert thresholds for drift
Documentation and runbook for oncall to interpret failures and trigger mitigation (fallback to FP16 or previous model)
Benchmarks: baseline runtime for full-suite run time < 45 minutes on dedicated 8xA100 pool for standard 2k-sample suite
implementation_plan: Phase 1: Design and data curation - finalize golden cohorts, labeling guidelines, sampling seeds, and metrics definition (2 weeks)
Phase 2: Core runner + metric library - implement replay engine, token-alignment collector, and FidelityScore aggregator (3 weeks)
Phase 3: Sensitivity probes - per-layer perturbation runners that compute layerwise loss delta and logit-shift maps (2 weeks)
Phase 4: Orchestration + CI hooks - integrate with internal CI, add canary workflow, and implement webhook rollback triggers (1 week)
Phase 5: Telemetry + dashboards - export granular telemetry to observability pipeline and build Grafana panels and alert rules (1 week)
Phase 6: Run pilot with two open models and one enterprise customer profile; collect feedback and tune adaptive thresholds (2 weeks)
Phase 7: Docs + runbook and handoff to SRE/QA (continuous)
Implementation notes: runner should be language-agnostic (Python venv), containerized, and accept model artifacts in Redwood standardized model tarball format
gating_logic: Composite FidelityScore = weighted_sum(similarity_score * 0.45, logit_kl_normalized * 0.35, task_regression_penalty * 0.20). Default pass if FidelityScore >= 0.92. Secondary rule: no single cohort regression > 1.5% absolute reduction in task accuracy. Thresholds are configurable per-release in /configs/quant_gates.json.
telemetry_requirements: Per-run: FidelityScore, similarity_score, logit_kl, task_regressions, median_latency, p95_latency, sample_count
Per-sample traces: token_deltas (N tokens truncated), attention-shift snapshots for top 3 layers
Per-layer sensitivity table: layer_index -> delta_loss -> recommended_quant_guard (skip/partial-quantize)
Longitudinal: time-series of FidelityScore by cohort for drift detection with seasonal baselines
Emit structured failure tags for quick filtering: [regression_type:logit|task|latency], [cohort], [context_length_bucket]
test_matrix: Quick smoke: 200 golden prompts across 3 cohorts (domain, length, difficulty) - run on PR
Full suite: 2k golden prompts with stratified sampling + adversarial perturbations - run on canary
Stress: 10k synthetic variations to validate stability and quant sampling variance
Calibration loop: run quant calibration + acceptance run to ensure calibration parameters do not introduce new regressions
Cross-model ensemble check: compare FP8 model vs INT8 vs baseline FP16 and produce discordance report
rollout_and_mitigation: If gate fails on canary: automatically trigger rollback webhook to DeploymentOrchestrator with details and recommend fallback profile
If regression localized to specific layer: propose partial-quant profile (skip quant for problematic layers) and schedule targeted calibration
If latency regression only: suggest batching/sequence-length profile adjustments and re-run acceptance
Manual escalation: attach FailureReport to incident channel and notify PM/ML lead for triage

notes: Avoid heavy name collisions with existing harnesses by focusing this ticket on orchestration and CI gating rather than standalone quant validators.
Design decision: make gates configurable via release profiles so enterprise customers can set stricter thresholds.
Future work: automated threshold tuning using Bayesian optimization and customer traffic-weighted cohorts
